verdict.rationale: An in-product AI assistant is a reasonable thing to ask of an LLM observability platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows external coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) connecting to Weave through the W&B MCP server and Skills. That is an adjacent integration, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to, and the Playground is a prompt and model testing tool rather than a delegating assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
